decisions.reason: As the flagship transactional email service central to the firm's cloud messaging direction, it retains high strategic option value and low uncertainty relative to its core position, so management keeps it open.
The specific customer result for Managed Capture Services indicates the option has begun to realize value, reducing uncertainty and justifying continued investment.
Email and fax conversion is a lower-priority option whose value remains modest but whose costs are low, so it is kept while the firm focuses on higher-value options.
Fax delivery optimization serves a declining but still present niche, and with little evidence of failure and low cost of maintaining the option, management keeps it for now.
Email sandbox threat protection aligns with the firm's security focus and has unresolved but promising prospects, so it is kept as a valuable option.
